semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Waaree Clean Energy Services provides green hydrogen solutions and ammonia production, which are increasingly important for sustainable semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Waaree Clean Energy Services offers green hydrogen solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-purity alkaline electrolysers and ammonia production. Their turnkey solutions include engineering, procurement, and construction services, as well as build, own, operate models for hydrogen production, supporting the industry's shift towards sustainable materials and processes.
capabilities: Turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services
Build, own, operate (BOO) models for hydrogen production
